title.narrative: SO1: Attitudes and practices of duty bearers and communities in the target areas towards CAR and CICL reflect a respect for their human dignity and their right to be protected from torture and CIDTP.

description.narrative: By 2023 a communitybased diversion program for CICL is operational in Bagong Silang (with allocated budget and LGU commitment).By 2023 at least 25 CICL from target area are enrolled in a Barangay diversion programme.By 2023 the child protection policy of the Barangay is disseminated and implemented.By 2023 a minimum of 2 community groups including CAR/CICL are maintained and strengthened in target area.By 2023 an enabling and supportive environment is created in target area allowing parents of CAR/CICL to communicate and relate well with other members of the community.By 2023 parents and community members collaborate to create the conditions to reduce the vulnerability of CAR and CICL to torture and other forms of violence and spare them from harm.

title.narrative: Number of programs and activities initiated for CAR/CICL by Barangay authorities in target area.

description.narrative: Number of programs and activities initiated for CAR/CICL by Barangay authorities in target area.

comment.narrative: According to the Actions Baseline study dutybearers in Bagong Silang regularly conduct 4 out of 12 secondary level preventive measures to assist CAR and dissuade them from engaging in activities and behaviors that would invite contact with law enforcement. 11 out of the 16 tertiary level measures were reportedly being delivered i.e. interventions to avoid further unnecessary contact of children with the formal justice system and measures to avoid reoffending. The project has not been able to verify the existence or quality of these programs. At the time of the Baseline study there was no communitybased diversion program in place.

As mentioned above this indicator is difficult to measure as it is not the quantity but the quality of programs offered to CAR and CICL that is most important. The quantitative indicator from the original logframe has been maintained however the result will be monitored also from a qualitative perspective.
